items.prompt: The meeting only needs orders per branch. What do you send?
items.explanation: Minimisation: share only what the purpose needs.

items.prompt: An ad vendor asks for customer names and phone numbers. Your move?

items.prompt: The Indonesian law that protects personal data is…
items.explanation: Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection sets how personal data may be processed.
